audit.notes: Extremely straightforward to recreate using existing footage: open with 3-4 seconds of studying or working on a laptop, then transition into a fast-paced sequence of fun travel clips, scenic sunsets, concerts, climbing, and hanging out with friends.
audit.summary: A motivational lifestyle reel contrasting a focused study session with a fast-paced montage of summer travel, concerts, sunsets, and adventures with friends.
